subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations in India advises people how to save petrol/diesel while driving?
solution:
The correct answer is **PCRA**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Petroleum Conservation Research Association (PCRA) **in India offers tips on how to reduce the amount of gasoline or diesel used when driving.
 
• The **Petroleum Conservation Research Association (PCRA)** was established in India in 1978 under the authority of the** Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas of India.**
 
• Its mission is to promote energy efficiency in a variety of economic sectors.
 
• In order to save money and lessen the impact of oil consumption on the environment, it aids the government in formulating policies and initiatives targeted at lowering India's reliance on oil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PRCA**

 
 
• **Pure red cell aplasia (PRCA)**, also known as **erythroblastopenia,** is a form of aplastic anaemia that primarily affects the progenitors of red blood cells but not usually those of white blood cells.
 
• The bone marrow stops producing red blood cells in **PRCA**. Many different aetiologies can result in **PRCA**.** Paul Kaznelson** initially wrote about the syndrome in 1922.
 
 
 
• **PARC**
 
 
• A research and development firm called **PARC** is located in **Palo Alto, California (formerly Xerox PARC). Jacob E. "Jack" Goldman,** the chief scientist of **Xerox Corporation,** founded the business in 1969.
 
• At the time, it was a branch of **Xerox** with the responsibility of developing hardware systems and products for the computer industry.
